events.label: Don Quixote Part I Published
events.fact: Miguel de Cervantes published the first part of his Spanish novel.

events.label: Frankenstein Published
events.fact: Mary Shelley published her Gothic science-fiction novel.

events.label: Moby-Dick Published
events.fact: Herman Melville published his tale of Captain Ahab and the white whale.

events.label: Adventures of Huckleberry Finn
events.fact: Mark Twain's novel published in the U.S. after its British release.

events.label: The Great Gatsby Published
events.fact: F. Scott Fitzgerald's Jazz Age novel set on Long Island.

events.label: Nineteen Eighty-Four Published
events.fact: George Orwell published his dystopian novel introducing "Big Brother".

events.label: To Kill a Mockingbird Published
events.fact: Harper Lee published her Pulitzer-winning novel set in Alabama.

events.label: One Hundred Years of Solitude
events.fact: Gabriel Garcia Marquez published his landmark magical realism novel.

events.label: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone
events.fact: First book in J.K. Rowling's wizarding series debuted in the U.K..
